sentences.text:
(Respondent No. 3 By Shri Nirendra Singh Tomar - Advocate)
 T h is appeal coming on for orders this day, t h e cou rt passed the
following

: 
 Order

Appellants/Claimants have filed this appeal under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 assailing the impugned award dated 8/8/2013 passed by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Shivpuri in Claim Case No. 173/2013; whereby, claim case filed by claimants under Section 166 of MV Act seeking total compensation of Rs. 43,50,000/- for the death of one Ummaidpuri (husband of appellant No. 1, father of appellant No. 2, son of appellants No. 3 and 4 and brother of appellants No. 5 and 6) has been dismissed by the Claims Tribunal on the ground that claimants failed to prove the factum of negligence of respondent no. 1-driver of offending vehicle in occurrence of accident.
2.

During pendency of the instant appeal, claimants have moved an application vide I.A.No.
336/2024 seeking direction of conversion of claim case filed by claimants before the Claims Tribunal from Section 166 to 163-A of Motor Vehicle Act and contest the case afresh.
3. This court is afraid that such direction can be passed after dismissal of claim case filed by claimants under Section 166 of MV Act before the Claims Tribunal on merits.

Further the claimants filed the claim case claiming income of the deceased 5,000/- per month and therefore, by itself the claim case was not maintainable if filed under Section 163-A of MV Act as outer limit of income of deceased under Section 163-A of the MV Act is 40,000/- per annum.
The appellants cannot be allowed to fill up the lacuna.
Therefore, I.A.No. 336/2024 is rejected.

4. As regards on merits, from perusal of impugned award as well as record, in the opinion of this Court, learned Claims tribunal did not err in passing the impugned award and findings as recorded by the Claims Tribunal while dismissing the claim case filed by claimants do not suffer from any perversity, illegality or irregularity.
The appeal sans merits and is hereby dismissed.
(ROOPESH CHANDRA VARSHNEY) JUDGE JPS/- Digitally signed by JAI PRAKASH SOLANKI JAI PRAKASH DN:
